ops.text: Delegated lane moved a shared branch ref while the lead was rebasing the same worktree (2026-09-30, cookiesync import child lane). A fable implementation lane in ~/.claude/worktrees/cookiesync/cookiesync-import was asked for "one second commit on top of 70ac96c" after it had already amended that commit to 1c2af90; it ran `git reset --soft 70ac96c` to reshape history at the same moment the lead rebased the branch onto main, leaving the branch on 70ac96c with the rebased tree uncommitted for about a minute. Restored from the reflog (8a215ce); the lane's in-flight delta became e649b5c. Lesson for briefs: a lane that may commit in a shared worktree gets "commit only; never reset, amend, rebase, checkout or move a ref; if the requested parent no longer matches HEAD, stop and report"; the lead rebases only after every lane in that worktree has reported idle.
